description: NaH₆TeO₆F crystallizes in the trigonal R3 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six O and one F atom. There are three shorter (2.39 Å) and three longer (2.66 Å) Na-O bond lengths. The Na-F bond length is 2.42 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a linear geometry to one O and one F atom. The H-O bond length is 1.03 Å. The H-F bond length is 1.51 Å. Te is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (1.95 Å) and three longer (1.96 Å) Te-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one H, and one Te atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, one H, and one Te atom. F is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to one Na and three equivalent H atoms.
